# Casa Del Mare

> Casa Del Mare is a 5-bedroom, 3-bathroom raised beach house in North Myrtle Beach, South Carolina that sleeps up to 14 guests, located less than a 5-minute walk from Cherry Grove Beach with direct Intracoastal Waterway access and a private dock.

Casa Del Mare ("House by the Sea") is a family-owned vacation rental on the Intracoastal Waterway in North Myrtle Beach, SC. It combines beach proximity with waterfront living: a private dock, hot tub, game room, and a large back deck with a gas grill and channel views. The home is professionally managed for booking and guest support, while the hospitality and design reflect the owning family's Italian heritage and focus on shared family time.

## Key Facts

- Address: 325 52nd Ave North, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
- Bedrooms: 5 | Bathrooms: 3 | Sleeps: up to 14 guests
- Beach distance: less than a 5-minute walk to Cherry Grove Beach
- Waterfront: direct access to the Intracoastal Waterway with a private dock
- Check-in: 4:00 p.m. Eastern Time
- Check-out: 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time
- Minimum stay: 2 nights
- Pets: not allowed
- Smoking/vaping: outside only, prohibited indoors
- Contact: familybeachtripsusa@gmail.com

## Amenities

- Private hot tub
- Indoor game room
- Fully equipped kitchen (ceramic flat-top range, granite counters, full-size refrigerator)
- Outdoor seating area with TV and waterway views
- Large back deck with gas grill
- Private dock for kayaks, paddleboards, and boats
- High-speed WiFi and in-unit laundry
